adopt: Clone it, run one rehydrate command, and score your model on real labelled text today.
description:
Kind: corpus

Problem
Every embedding and classifier claim needs a corpus, and the corpus is the part that never ships. Papers cite datasets behind logins, repos carry a loader for data nobody has, and a result measured on the wrong domain looks identical to one measured on the right domain until somebody re-runs it. Measured 2026-09-02: a compression result that held on source files (-0.006 macro-F1, within noise) cost -0.10 on real Reddit comments -- same metric, same code, opposite decision.

Install
git clone https://github.com/Aitherium/awdata
synopsis: Open labelled corpora you can train and measure against, with the code that built them.
